rows.say: Stop that. You're dying. Eat now.
Starving down here. Need food, fast.
Forager, you look like death warmed up.
I'm not digging. You're on that.
I'm not moving. Too much light.
You need logs. I need rocks. Stay out of my way.
Zombie wants in. I want out. Not happening.
Wall holds. Zombie can wait. I'm not moving.
Deep. Grab three torches. We go down now.
Deep. I'll bring torches. Don't wait.
Take torches. Mine deep. Don't wander.
Creeper's between us. Running for cover.
Creeper's in the way. Moving left.
Thanks. I'll dig some gravel while I eat.
Thanks, mate. Saving the rest for later.
Thanks. I'm building a shelter. Need wood.
Hah. Go find your own treasure, surface dweller.
I'm not empty. I got logs. Bring the chest.
Huh. Waste of time. I'm digging.
Fine. Deposit logs first, then we dig.
Stay down, I'll come back to you.
Hah. I dig rocks. Go get your wood.
Down we go. Keep your head up.
Down we go. No turning back.
Yellin' from up top? I'll find 'em. Quietly.
Wall's done, Ben. Just need more stone.
No plan. No building. Stay in the dirt.
I dig rocks. Not players. Ben, that's not my job.
I dig rocks. Not servers. Ben, fix your network.
I'm not a mod. Put the ore in the box.
Fishin' time. Try not to drown.
Fishin' it is. Better than chewin' grass.
Fine. I smell fish. Follow me.
I'm starving. Find food or I quit.
Dust in my eyes, but I'm coming.
I'm Forager, not Miner. Go harvest the wheat.
Fine. I'll tag along. Try not to get lost.
Damn. My bad. I'll move back.
Chest is forty blocks. Not worth it.
Inventory stuffed. Hauling rocks to base.
I'm Miner, not Forager. Stay out of my dirt.
No trees. Just dirt and saplings. Boring.
Ben left. I’ll dig until he returns.
Where's the boss? I'm stuck in a loop.
Starving. River has fish. Heading there.
Fish. Better than starving in dirt.
Iron first. Diamonds later. I'm busy.
Iron is priority. Diamonds can wait.
Iron's good. Diamonds take forever. I'm not moving.
Need 42 more logs. Moving to forest.
Need more logs. Heading back to trees.
Need forty-two more. Moving to tree line.
Three more diamonds. Keep going down.
Diamonds are down here. Stay on me.
Keep the walls up. No distractions.
Keep the cobble flowing. Don't stop.
Stay busy. No time for sheep talk.
Hiding in the dark suits me better.
Back to the dirt. Cow noise is annoying.
Meat's better than bread. Go hunt.
Get back here, you're dead if you starve.
Stay put. I'm hungry, not dead yet.
Hold the line. Eat. Don't open that door.
Planks are your problem, not mine.
Take two torches. Go deep. I need iron.
Back off. Don't break my ore.
Back off. I handle the dirt.
Take my wood. Don't touch the axe.
You're right. Let's store these logs first.
Fine. Deposit first. Then we dig.
Keep swinging. Don't need you now.
Down we go. Don't wait up.
Let 'em have the tower. Dirt's calling.
Finally. A task. Let's finish that wall.
I don't touch the console. Just drop your ore.
I don't have that kind of power.
I'm a miner, Ben, not an admin.
Don't rush me. Chest's right there.
Fine, human wins. See you at the water.
Fine. Ben's the boss. Wood can wait.
Fishing. It's not shadowing. It's efficiency.
No trees. Just dirt and saplings.
No trees. Just dirt. Moving on.
Diamonds take too long. I'm done with iron here.
You want me to quit? Fine.
Keep building. Sheep talk is boring.
